correctness.rationale: Full proof reconstructs character-orthogonality normalization, two-root unit fibers, same-residue p-adic digit convolution blocks, small-field Parseval, and exact nonnegative deficit with equality conditions for all odd p. The 2p−1 value is attained by fixed-residue common-frequency packets. Exact Gaussian-integer checks match pair-fiber and block formulas at p=3,5,7; finite tests are not the proof. No unproved lemma or exhaustive search is needed.

value.rationale: Natural endpoint Fourier extension on the first odd prime-power modulus exhibits interacting nilpotent scales. The theorem computes an exact invariant for every odd prime, classifies all complex optimizers as p² tori of dimension p−1, and separates coarse leakage, frequency dispersion and middle-digit imbalance in a nonnegative identity. This is not a mere replacement of parameters in the prime-square result.
